tiles.title: Design system — Playful consumer
tiles.hero:
Fresh out the oven

Little joys,
delivered.

Coral, sunshine and sky blue. Pills, chunky shadows, a bounce.

OrderTrackRate
tiles.text:
## Principles

- Joy in the details: a bounce, a color, a friendly word.
- Bright fills, dark words: labels on coral and yellow stay dark; colored text uses link.
- Big and tappable: pill buttons, chunky controls.

## Starter profile

- **Fits:** consumer apps, food, delivery, games, social, entertainment, kids brands. Not for legal, finance, healthcare.
- **Mood:** playful, loud; density medium; shape pill; contrast standard; light first.
- **Type:** Baloo 2, Nunito Sans, ui-monospace.
- **Adapt first:** primary, secondary, accent, link. **Keep:** primary-foreground, motion-base.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colors, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each color shows its light and dark values and is checked against the color it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by color alone.
